g.text: Treasury age profile for the year ending March 2019; taxes shown below zero
Tax payments and public benefits vary across the life course
Published historical age profile: Cross-section, not lifetime accounts. Covers selected direct/indirect taxes, in-kind health/education and
income support. Omits other budget items; does not measure each person's net contribution.
Sources: Treasury LTFS 2025 official figure data; LTFM and OLG identified separately
